0.7.3 is a drop-in patch for 0.7.0, 0.7.1 and 0.7.2: format epoch 3 is unchanged, with no storage, snapshot or Raft protocol change. Upgrade in place with an ordinary rolling restart (`helm upgrade`). No fresh install or data move is needed.

- **Upgrade order.** Upgrading gateways before voters, and rolling back voters before gateways, is recommended, not required. Clients count the new `x-ursula-not-applied` marker only with the vouch `x-ursula-not-applied-checked`, which only gateways from 0.7.3 on send, so no upgrade or rollback order makes a client trust a false marker. From 0.7.0, a values file that pins `global.image.tag` or `gateway.image.tag` must move it together with the chart, as for 0.7.1. A configuration that sets `storage.cold.s3.probe_timeout`, `storage.cold.s3.unhealthy_ticks`, `storage.cold.s3.heal_ticks` or `governance.leadership_balance.peer_timeout` to `0` no longer loads.
- **Refusals that applied nothing are marked.** A node marks the write refusals it can tell came before any proposal (admission pressure such as `RaftLogPressure`, most `NotLeader` and `GroupNotHosted` redirects, and backpressure), and the gateway marks its own refusals and vouches for the markers it returns. A proxy or service mesh in front of the gateway must not retry writes or follow redirects for them. Nothing between the gateway and the nodes may resend requests or answer `401`, `402` or `429`.
- **The gateway follows leader redirects itself** ([#460](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/460)), so its clients no longer get `307`s. When it finds no leader within three further hops and 5 s, it answers `503` with `Retry-After: 1`. A plain append without a producer or `Stream-Seq` can now apply up to four times, so use a producer for exactly-once writes.
- **One failed S3 health probe no longer moves every leadership** ([#508](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/508)). The store gate sheds after three bad ticks (`storage.cold.s3.unhealthy_ticks`, was `1`) with a `5s` probe deadline (`storage.cold.s3.probe_timeout`, was `2s`), keeps a failed cold-flush write counting until a later write succeeds, and hands off at most four leaderships per tick, only to peers that may campaign.
- **Self-election on the leader** answers `409` and leaves the term unchanged, instead of starting an election that could violate an OpenRaft invariant and, in debug builds, stop the core thread ([#516](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/516)).
- **SQLite VFS (experimental).** A commit refused before it reaches the stream, by a `401`, a `429`, a vouched marker or its size over `URSULA_VFS_MAX_FRAME_BYTES` (32 MiB by default), fails alone instead of poisoning the database. The extension never follows redirects, keeps connections for 90 s (`URSULA_VFS_IDLE_MS`), times out resolving and connecting after 5 s, backs off from snapshots that keep failing, bounds its measurements and contains panics, and `instrument()` drains every second. Upgrade `@tonbo/sqlite-ursula` together with the extension.
- **Rust library APIs changed** in `ursula-gateway` (`GatewayError::LeaderUnreachable` and `GatewayError::LeaderNotFound`), `ursula-raft`, `ursula-config` and `ursula`, with additions in `ursula-proto` and `ursula-runtime` (`RefusedBeforeProposal`), and no wire or on-disk change.

Known issues: [#411](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/411), [#517](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/517), [#518](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/518), [#519](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/519), [#529](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/529), [#539](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/539), [#540](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/540) and [#542](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/542). Every change is listed in the [0.7.3 release notes](https://ursula.tonbo.io/docs/release-notes#073).
